# Tokens

Every token of the system, a section per group: Surfaces — 1 token; Text — 1 token; Borders and rings — 2 tokens; Palette ramps and brand — 28 tokens; Type styles, families, font files; Spacing — 6 tokens; Radius — 3 tokens; Shadow — 4 tokens.

## Color · Surfaces

### Use

```css
/* any surface that loads tokens.css or components/bundle.css */
color: var(--background);
/* a surface with no stylesheet (a slide): the senin-light value, or another theme’s in that mode */
```

### Tokens (1)

| token | senin-light | senin-dark | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `background` | #f4f7fa | #131920 | Page ground behind everything. |

## Type

Use the named styles; no literal px. Figtree, friendly and open. One family, four steps: 22, 15, 14, 12. The system's own monospace; no font file to host.

### Use

```css
font: var(--text-pc-title);            /* with tokens.css */
font-family: var(--font-sans);   /* the family alone */
```

### Styles

| style | CSS | size / line | weight | family | usage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pc-title` | `.pc-title`, `--text-pc-title` | 22px / 28px | 700 | `sans` | Page titles. |
| `pc-heading` | `.pc-heading`, `--text-pc-heading` | 15px / 20px | 600 | `sans` | Card titles, sidebar app name. |
| `pc-body` | `.pc-body`, `--text-pc-body` | 14px / 20px | 400 | `sans` | Everything else. |
| `pc-small` | `.pc-small`, `--text-pc-small` | 12px / 16px | 500 | `sans` | Dates, counts, descriptions. |
| `pc-mono` | `.pc-mono`, `--text-pc-mono` | 12px / 18px | 400 | `mono` | Client IDs, secrets, error codes, job arguments. |

### Families

| family | CSS variable | stack |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `sans` | `--font-sans` | `Figtree, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif` |
| `mono` | `--font-mono` | `ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace` |

## Spacing

4px base. One row height for sidebar rows, task rows, buttons and inputs.

### Use

```css
padding: var(--pc-space-1);
```

### Tokens (6)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pc-space-1` | 4px | Icon to label inside a badge. |
| `pc-space-2` | 8px | Inside controls. |
| `pc-space-3` | 12px | Between fields in a form. |
| `pc-space-4` | 16px | Card padding. |
| `pc-space-6` | 24px | Page padding, between cards. |
| `pc-row` | 32px | Height of every row and control: sidebar, menu, search, task and table rows, calendar days, buttons, inputs and selects. |

## Radius

Soft, three steps. Checkboxes stay square-ish; avatars and badges are round.

### Use

```css
/* var(--pc-radius-sm) */
```

### Tokens (3)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pc-radius-sm` | 5px | Checkboxes. |
| `pc-radius` | 10px | Rows, buttons, inputs. |
| `pc-radius-lg` | 14px | Cards and app frame. |

## Shadow

Two lifts: pc-raise for cards and the open task; pc-raise-lg for menus, dialogs and tooltips; pc-focus for keyboard focus on controls, pc-focus-inset on rows.

### Use

```css
/* var(--pc-raise) */
```

### Tokens (4)

| token | value | usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pc-raise` | 0 1px 2px #1c27331a, 0 2px 8px #1c27330f · senin-dark: 0 1px 3px #000000a6 | Cards, the active sidebar row and the open task. |
| `pc-raise-lg` | 0 8px 24px #1c27331f, 0 2px 6px #1c27330f · senin-dark: 0 8px 24px #00000099 | Things that open over the page: menus, dialogs, tooltips. |
| `pc-focus` | 0 0 0 1px #2563eb, 0 0 6px 1px #1e40af99 · senin-dark: 0 0 0 1px #60a5fa, 0 0 6px 1px #2563eb99 | Keyboard focus on every control and row: a 1px ring line on the edge and a soft glow in a darker blue. Each control also turns its own outer 1px into the colour of the surface behind it (as on claude.ai). |
| `pc-focus-inset` | inset 0 0 0 1px #2563eb, 0 0 6px 1px #1e40af99 · senin-dark: inset 0 0 0 1px #60a5fa, 0 0 6px 1px #2563eb99 | Keyboard focus on rows (sidebar, menu, search, calendar days, table rows), as on claude.ai: the 1px ring inside the row's own edge, only the glow outside. |
